Meet your new favorite carry-all. This Basic Canvas Tote Bag features a classic, open-top design without a zipper, giving you effortless access to your essentials. Crafted from durable cotton canvas, it’s the perfect blend of simplicity, durability, and functionality for school, work, or daily errands.

KEY FEATURES:

Premium Cotton Canvas: Made from heavy-duty, high-quality canvas fabric that is built to last and holds its shape beautifully.

No-Zipper Open Top: Offers a casual, laid-back look and makes packing or grabbing your items incredibly quick and easy.

Heavy-Duty Stitching: Reinforced cross-stitching on the handles ensures the bag can securely carry your books, laptop, or groceries.

Perfect for DIY: Clean, blank surface is ideal for fabric paint, embroidery, iron-on patches, or decorating with pins.

SIZE GUIDE & MEASUREMENTS:

Size 10x12 inches: Compact and lightweight. Perfectly fits a tablet/iPad, small notebooks, wallet, phone, and keys. Great for quick errands or casual outings.

Size 15x16 inches: Spacious and roomy. Easily holds a 14" to 15.6" laptop, A4 binders, textbooks, a water bottle, and daily essentials. Perfect for students and commuters.

PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS:

Material: 100% Cotton Canvas

Closure: None (Open Top)

Style: Shoulder Bag / Reusable Shopping Bag

CARE INSTRUCTIONS:

Hand wash with cold water and mild detergent.

Line dry in the shade to prevent shrinkage.

Iron on medium heat if needed to remove wrinkles.
